description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object for filtering employee timesheet list search results in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee numbers and actionable states, and sets default sorting parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Extends FilterParams to provide specific filtering options for employee timesheet listings, allowing filtering by employee numbers and actionable states, with default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering the timesheet list.

methods.name: getActionableStatesList
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable states used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setActionableStatesList
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable states for filtering the timesheet list.
